_note: SRD 5.1 spells only. 'target': enemy | cone (target + 2 near it) | line (target + 3) | enemies | ally | allies | self. FF-simple targeting stands in for areas.

firebolt.name: Fire Bolt
firebolt.desc: Cantrip. Spell attack, 1d10 fire (2d10 at level 5).

light.name: Light
light.desc: Cantrip. Bright light for the fight. Things that hate light, hate it.

burninghands.name: Burning Hands
burninghands.desc: A fan of flame: 3d6 fire to up to three foes, DEX save for half.

magicmissile.name: Magic Missile
magicmissile.desc: Three darts that never miss, 1d4+1 force each, at one foe or several.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.desc: 5d8 hit points of creatures fall asleep, weakest first.

mageArmor.name: Mage Armor
mageArmor.desc: An unarmored ally: AC 13 + DEX until the next long rest.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.desc: A wave of force: 2d8 thunder to up to three foes, CON half.

scorchingray.name: Scorching Ray
scorchingray.desc: Three rays, each a spell attack for 2d6 fire, at one foe or several.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.desc: 3d8 thunder to up to three foes, CON half.

web.name: Web
web.desc: Up to three foes: DEX save or restrained.

holdperson.name: Hold Person
holdperson.desc: A humanoid: WIS save or paralyzed. It saves again each turn.

mistystep.name: Misty Step
mistystep.desc: A bonus action: silver mist, and you are 30 ft away (on the grid: DEEP16's fights).
mistystep.src: SRD 5.1; RULED 09-27 (Griz): a spell the wizard can learn at level-up, not lent (grid: no 8-bit battle or field use)

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: 8d6 fire to every foe, DEX half.

lightningbolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightningbolt.desc: 8d6 lightning down a line of up to four foes, DEX half.

bless.name: Bless
bless.desc: Up to three allies add 1d4 to attacks and saves; one more for each slot level above 1st.

curewounds.name: Cure Wounds
curewounds.desc: Heals 1d8 + the caster's spellcasting modifier. One who is down comes round.

shieldoffaith.name: Shield of Faith
shieldoffaith.desc: Bonus action. +2 AC to one ally.

divinefavor.name: Divine Favor
divinefavor.desc: Bonus action. Your weapon hits deal +1d4 radiant.

heroism.name: Heroism
heroism.desc: No fear, and temporary HP equal to your CHA bonus at the start of each of its turns.

lesserrestoration.name: Lesser Restoration
lesserrestoration.desc: Ends one thing, as the SRD has it: paralysis, blindness or poison (a paralysing poison is one); on the grid also the disease (Contagion, with its poison and blinding) and deafness. A player picks where there is more than one, an NPC takes the worst. Not built: any other disease.
lesserrestoration.src: SRD 5.1 (Oath of Devotion oath spell, 5th level)

aid.name: Aid
aid.desc: Up to three allies: +5 max and current HP until the next long rest.

smite.name: Divine Smite
smite.desc: Attack; on a hit spend a slot for +2d8 radiant (3d8 from a 2nd-level slot; +1d8 vs undead or fiends).

acidsplash.name: Acid Splash
acidsplash.desc: Cantrip. A bubble of acid on up to two foes: DEX save or 2d6 acid.

icestorm.name: Ice Storm
icestorm.desc: Hail on every foe: 2d8 bludgeoning and 4d6 cold, DEX half.

greaterinvisibility.name: Greater Invisibility
greaterinvisibility.desc: An ally turns invisible: attacks on it at disadvantage, its attacks at advantage, for the fight.

stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
stoneskin.desc: An ally's skin turns stone-hard: half damage from mundane blows, for the fight.

coneofcold.name: Cone of Cold
coneofcold.desc: 8d8 cold to up to three foes, CON half.

holdmonster.name: Hold Monster
holdmonster.desc: Any creature: WIS save or paralyzed. It saves again at the end of each turn.

revivify.name: Revivify
revivify.desc: A fallen ally is back up at 1 HP. Burns a diamond worth 300 gp.

daylight.name: Daylight
daylight.desc: A sphere of daylight. Things that hate light, hate it more.
daylight.src: SRD 5.1 (Daylight; spec §9: the Sunshaft's own spell)

dancinglights.name: Dancing Lights
dancinglights.desc: Cantrip. Four hovering lights, dim 10 ft round each; a bonus action moves them. Light enough to see by, and lawful under a roost.
dancinglights.src: SRD 5.1 (Dancing Lights); torchdark 09-28 (the DARK verdict of the spell list; dim light lawful under the roost RULED 09-28)

fogcloud.name: Fog Cloud
fogcloud.desc: A 20-ft sphere of fog: nothing sees in, out or across it. Here, RUN slips away under it untried. Cast from outside a Globe of Invulnerability, it does not cover the squares inside the globe.

continualflame.name: Continual Flame
continualflame.desc: A heatless flame, torch-bright, on an ally's weapon. It never goes out, and it is always lit: the roost's mouth will stop it.
continualflame.src: SRD 5.1 (Continual Flame); torchdark 09-28 (the ruby not asked for: nothing but the rest spells consumes a component, RULED 09-28)

darkvision.name: Darkvision
darkvision.desc: An ally sees in the dark to 60 ft, grey and plain, until the next long rest.

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.desc: An ally goes unseen: attacks by them have advantage, at them disadvantage, till they attack or cast.

seeinvisibility.name: See Invisibility
seeinvisibility.desc: You see the invisible for the fight, ghostly and grey.

stinkingcloud.name: Stinking Cloud
stinkingcloud.desc: A 20-ft sphere of yellow, nauseating gas over the foes: each turn inside it, CON save or the turn goes on retching.

sleetstorm.name: Sleet Storm
sleetstorm.desc: Freezing sleet over the foes: ice underfoot, DEX save each turn or prone; exposed flames go out.

mislead.name: Mislead
mislead.desc: You go invisible, and a double of you stands where you stood, till you attack or cast.

passwithouttrace.name: Pass Without Trace
passwithouttrace.desc: A veil of shadow and silence: +10 Stealth for all of yours within 30 ft.
passwithouttrace.src: SRD 5.1 (Pass Without Trace); torchdark 09-28 (the grid only: no druid or ranger casts yet)

trueseeing.name: True Seeing
trueseeing.desc: Truesight 120 ft: the dark, the fog and the invisible are nothing to them.
trueseeing.src: SRD 5.1 (True Seeing); torchdark 09-28 (the grid only: no hero reaches 6th)

chilltouch.name: Chill Touch
chilltouch.desc: Cantrip. Spell attack, 120 ft: 1d8 necrotic (2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11). A hit foe cannot regain hit points until your next turn; an undead hit also attacks you at disadvantage until the end of your next turn.
chilltouch.src: SRD 5.1 Chill Touch (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

poisonspray.name: Poison Spray
poisonspray.desc: Cantrip. A foe within 10 ft makes a CON save or takes 1d12 poison (2d12 at level 5, 3d12 at 11); nothing on a save. A creature immune to poison is untouched. A creature under Protection from Poison saves with advantage.
poisonspray.src: SRD 5.1 Poison Spray (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

produceflame.name: Produce Flame
produceflame.desc: Cantrip. Spell attack, 30 ft: 1d8 fire (2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11). Not built: the flame kept burning in your hand as a light.
produceflame.src: SRD 5.1 Produce Flame (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

rayoffrost.name: Ray of Frost
rayoffrost.desc: Cantrip. Spell attack, 60 ft: 1d8 cold (2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11), and a hit foe loses 10 ft of speed until the start of your next turn.
rayoffrost.src: SRD 5.1 Ray of Frost (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

resistance.name: Resistance
resistance.desc: Cantrip. Touch yourself or an adjacent ally: +1d4 to the next saving throw they roll, added automatically, then spent. Concentration, a minute. Not built: choosing which save.

sacredflame.name: Sacred Flame
sacredflame.src: SRD 5.1 Sacred Flame (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js); RULED 09-28g (Griz): Ingrith is a cleric in the 8-bit game too: her spells cast in its battle (js/battle.js)
sacredflame.desc: Cantrip. DEX save or 1d8 radiant (2d8 at level 5).

shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
shillelagh.desc: Cantrip. Bonus action: your club or quarterstaff attacks and damages with WIS, deals 1d8, and is magical. Lasts the fight, no concentration. Not built: the one-minute limit.

shockinggrasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shockinggrasp.desc: Cantrip. Melee spell attack: 1d8 lightning (2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11), advantage on a target in metal armour (a hero or class NPC in mail or plate). A hit foe takes no reactions until its next turn starts.
shockinggrasp.src: SRD 5.1 Shocking Grasp (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

truestrike.name: True Strike
truestrike.desc: Cantrip. A foe within 30 ft: on your next turn your first attack roll against it has advantage, and that attack spends it. Concentration, 1 round, held through that turn.
truestrike.src: SRD 5.1 True Strike (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

viciousmockery.name: Vicious Mockery
viciousmockery.desc: Cantrip. A foe within 60 ft that can hear you (not a deafened one) makes a WIS save or takes 1d4 psychic (2d4 at level 5, 3d4 at 11) and rolls its next attack at disadvantage, until the end of its next turn.
viciousmockery.src: SRD 5.1 Vicious Mockery (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

eldritchblast.name: Eldritch Blast
eldritchblast.desc: Cantrip. One beam (two at level 5, three at 11, four at 17), 120 ft, each a spell attack for 1d10 force at targets you choose. Agonizing Blast adds CHA to each; Repelling Blast pushes a hit foe 10 ft.
eldritchblast.src: SRD 5.1 Eldritch Blast (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.desc: Cantrip. Touch yourself or an adjacent ally: +1d4 to one ability check, once -- breaking free of a grip, web or vines, or Hide (spent after the roll, when the d4 could turn a miss); the spell ends once used. Concentration. Not built: any other ability check (the grid rolls no others).

bane.name: Bane
bane.desc: Up to three foes within 30 ft (one more per slot above 1st) make a CHA save; each that fails rolls -1d4 on every attack roll and saving throw. Concentration, a minute.

colorspray.name: Color Spray
colorspray.desc: A 15-ft cone from you: rolls 6d10 (+2d10 per slot above 1st) hit points of creatures, weakest first, and blinds those it covers until the end of your next turn. Allies in the cone count.
colorspray.src: SRD 5.1 Color Spray (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

command.name: Command
command.src: SRD 5.1 Command (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js); RULED 09-28g (Griz): "they have to be able to transfer back and forth from 16bit fights": the 8-bit battle casts it too (js/battle.js)
command.desc: One word, WIS save: GROVEL, HALT, FLEE or DROP. It obeys on its turn, and the turn is gone. Not the dead, nor the witless.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.desc: A 20-ft square within 90 ft: everyone in it, friend or foe, makes a STR save or is restrained by vines (an action and a STR check against your DC frees them); the ground is difficult. Concentration, a minute.

expeditiousretreat.name: Expeditious Retreat
expeditiousretreat.desc: Bonus action, yourself. Concentration, 10 minutes. Casting it gives you a Dash that turn, free (the cast is the bonus action): your speed again in movement. From your next turn, RETREAT DASH: a Dash as your bonus action each turn. Held fast or dancing, there is no move to add a Dash to. The AI casts it to close on a foe it cannot reach by the walk, and takes the bonus Dash to close or to get clear.
expeditiousretreat.src: SRD 5.1 Expeditious Retreat (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

falselife.name: False Life
falselife.desc: Yourself: 1d4+4 temporary hit points (+5 per slot above 1st); the larger of old and new stands. Lasts the fight.
falselife.src: SRD 5.1 False Life (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

grease.name: Grease
grease.note8: the 8-bit battle (RULED 10-01c, Griz: 'work a simplified version into 8-bit battles'): up to three foes, DEX or prone
grease.desc: A 10-ft square within 60 ft becomes difficult ground: creatures in it save DEX or fall prone, and so does anyone who steps in or ends a turn there. Lasts a minute (ten rounds), no concentration.

guidingbolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guidingbolt.desc: Spell attack, 120 ft: 4d6 radiant (+1d6 per slot above 1st). The next attack roll against the target, by anyone, has advantage until the end of your next turn.
guidingbolt.src: SRD 5.1 Guiding Bolt (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

healingword.name: Healing Word
healingword.src: SRD 5.1 Healing Word (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js); RULED 09-28g (Griz): Ingrith is a cleric in the 8-bit game too: her spells cast in its battle (js/battle.js)
healingword.desc: Bonus action. A word at range: 1d4 + WIS back to one ally (+1d4 a slot above 1st).

hellishrebuke.name: Hellish Rebuke
hellishrebuke.desc: Reaction, offered when a foe's attack hits you and you can see it within 60 ft: 2d10 fire (+1d10 per slot above 1st), DEX save for half. Spends your lowest slot; never cast from the list.
hellishrebuke.src: SRD 5.1 Hellish Rebuke (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

hideouslaughter.name: Hideous Laughter
hideouslaughter.note8: the 8-bit battle (RULED 10-01c, Griz: 'laughter is single target (no 8-bit easter egg)'): one foe, WIS or prone and helpless with laughter, the save again each turn and, with advantage, each time it is hurt (10-03); INT 4 or less unmoved
hideouslaughter.desc: A foe within 30 ft makes a WIS save or falls prone and incapacitated with laughter, saving again at the end of each of its turns and, with advantage, when hurt. INT 4 or less is unmoved. Concentration, a minute.
hideouslaughter.src: SRD 5.1 Hideous Laughter (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

huntersmark.name: Hunter's Mark
huntersmark.desc: Bonus action: mark a foe within 90 ft; your weapon hits on it deal +1d6. Concentration; when it drops, a bonus action moves the mark with no slot. Not built: the Perception and Survival bonus to find it.
huntersmark.src: SRD 5.1 Hunter's Mark (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

mirrorsgaze.name: Mirror's Gaze
mirrorsgaze.desc: Bonus action: hold a foe within 90 ft in the mirror. Your weapon or spell hits on it deal +1d6 psychic, and it cannot hide from you (unseen, hidden or in darkness). Concentration; a bonus action moves it when it drops.
mirrorsgaze.src: game-original (RULED 09-28, the ear file dist-2): built on the SRD's Hunter's Mark

inflictwounds.name: Inflict Wounds
inflictwounds.desc: Melee spell attack, touch: 3d10 necrotic (+1d10 per slot above 1st).
inflictwounds.src: SRD 5.1 Inflict Wounds (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

longstrider.name: Longstrider
longstrider.desc: Touch yourself or an adjacent ally: speed +10 ft for the fight, no concentration. Not built: extra targets at higher slots.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.src: SRD 5.1 Sanctuary (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js); RULED 09-28g (Griz): "they have to be able to transfer back and forth from 16bit fights": the 8-bit battle casts it too (js/battle.js)
sanctuary.desc: Bonus action. One ally is warded: a foe must pass a WIS save to strike it, else it turns elsewhere. Ends if the ally attacks or casts at a foe.

faeriefire.name: Faerie Fire
faeriefire.desc: A 20-ft cube within 60 ft: each creature in it makes a DEX save or is outlined: attacks against it have advantage, and it cannot hide or gain from being invisible. Concentration, a minute. Not built: the light it sheds, outlined objects.
faeriefire.src: SRD 5.1 Faerie Fire (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

glasswhisper.name: Glass Whisper
glasswhisper.desc: A foe within 60 ft that can hear you (not a deafened one) makes a WIS save or takes 2d6 psychic (+1d6 per slot above 1st), half on a save; on a fail it also takes no reactions until the end of its next turn.
glasswhisper.src: game-original (RULED 09-28, the ear file dist-6): the pact of the Mirror's own harm

protectionfromevilandgood.name: Protection from Evil and Good
protectionfromevilandgood.src: SRD 5.1 Protection from Evil and Good (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js); RULED 09-28g (Griz): "they have to be able to transfer back and forth from 16bit fights": the 8-bit battle casts it too (js/battle.js)
protectionfromevilandgood.desc: One ally: the dead, fiends, fey, elementals, aberrations and celestials attack it at disadvantage, and cannot frighten it.

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.desc: A 15-ft sphere of magical darkness at a point within 60 ft: no one sees in, out or across it (truesight and Devil's Sight do), and torchlight does not reach it. Cast from outside a Globe of Invulnerability, it does not cover the squares inside the globe: they are no part of its area. Concentration, 10 minutes. Not built: hanging it on an object.

acidarrow.name: Acid Arrow
acidarrow.desc: Spell attack, 90 ft: 4d4 acid now and 2d4 more at the end of its next turn; a miss splashes half the first and nothing after. Each slot above 2nd adds 1d4 to both.
acidarrow.src: SRD 5.1 Acid Arrow (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

barkskin.name: Barkskin
barkskin.desc: Touch yourself or an adjacent ally: AC cannot be lower than 16, whatever they wear. Concentration, up to an hour.

blindnessdeafness.name: Blindness/Deafness
blindnessdeafness.desc: A foe within 30 ft makes a CON save or is blinded, saving again at the end of each of its turns. Not built: the deafness choice, and extra targets at higher slots.

blur.name: Blur
blur.desc: Yourself: attacks against you have disadvantage, unless the attacker has blindsight within its range or truesight. Concentration, a minute.

brandingsmite.name: Branding Smite
brandingsmite.src: SRD 5.1 Branding Smite (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js); RULED 09-28g (Griz): "they have to be able to transfer back and forth from 16bit fights": the 8-bit battle casts it too (js/battle.js)
brandingsmite.desc: Bonus action. Your next weapon hit: +2d6 radiant (+1d6 a slot above 2nd), and the one struck cannot hide in invisibility.

enhanceability.name: Enhance Ability
enhanceability.desc: Touch, concentration, up to an hour: choose one of six aspects, advantage on checks of its ability -- Bear's Endurance (CON, and 2d6 temporary HP, lost when the spell ends), Bull's Strength (STR: tearing free of a web or grip), Cat's Grace (DEX: slipping a grip, Hide), Eagle's Splendor (CHA), Fox's Cunning (INT), Owl's Wisdom (WIS). A player picks from a list, Bear's first; an NPC takes Bull's Strength for one held or webbed, else Bear's. Not built: extra targets from a higher slot; doubled carrying capacity; Cat's Grace's no-damage fall (nothing falls on the grid); the CHA, INT, WIS and CON checks themselves (the grid rolls none).
enhanceability.src: SRD 5.1 Enhance Ability (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

enlargereduce.name: Enlarge/Reduce
enlargereduce.desc: A creature within 30 ft. An ally grows: +1d4 on weapon hits, advantage on STR checks and saves. A foe shrinks on a failed CON save: -1d4 on weapon hits (min 1), disadvantage on STR checks and saves. Concentration, a minute.

flameblade.name: Flame Blade
flameblade.desc: Bonus action: a blade of fire in your hand. Each action after, a melee spell attack with it, 3d6 fire (+1d6 per two slots above 2nd). Concentration, 10 minutes. Not built: the light it sheds.
flameblade.src: SRD 5.1 Flame Blade (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

gustofwind.name: Gust of Wind
gustofwind.desc: A 60-ft line from you, once: creatures in it save STR or are pushed 15 ft away, and fog, stinking and killing clouds in it blow apart. Not built: the minute-long gust, its drag on movement, snuffed flames.
gustofwind.src: SRD 5.1 Gust of Wind (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

heatmetal.name: Heat Metal
heatmetal.desc: A foe within 60 ft: 2d8 fire (+1d8 per slot above 2nd), no save; then CON or it drops a held weapon (no weapon attacks on its next turn), or in armour it can't shed has disadvantage on attacks and ability checks until your next turn. A bonus action repeats the burn each turn. Concentration.
heatmetal.src: SRD 5.1 Heat Metal (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

magicweapon.name: Magic Weapon
magicweapon.src: SRD 5.1 Magic Weapon (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js); RULED 09-28g (Griz): "they have to be able to transfer back and forth from 16bit fights": the 8-bit battle casts it too (js/battle.js)
magicweapon.desc: Bonus action. One ally's weapon becomes +1 (+2 from a 4th-level slot): to hit and damage, and magical.

mirrorimage.name: Mirror Image
mirrorimage.note8: the 8-bit battle (RULED 10-01c): three images; a hit on the caster may burst one instead
mirrorimage.desc: Yourself: three illusory doubles for a minute. An attack on you may land on one instead (d20: 6+ with three, 8+ with two, 11+ with one); a hit pops it, AC 10 + DEX. Not built: foes with blindsight or truesight ignoring them.
mirrorimage.src: SRD 5.1 Mirror Image (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

protectionfrompoison.name: Protection from Poison
protectionfrompoison.desc: Touch yourself or an adjacent ally: ends one poison on them (poisoned, or a poison's paralysis); for the fight, poison damage to them is halved and they save with advantage against poison (a blade's venom, the chuul's grip, a stinking cloud, Poison Spray, Cloudkill).
protectionfrompoison.src: SRD 5.1 Protection from Poison (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

rayofenfeeblement.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
rayofenfeeblement.desc: Ranged spell attack, 60 ft: a hit foe deals half damage with melee Strength weapon blows, saving CON at the end of each of its turns to end it. Concentration, a minute.
rayofenfeeblement.src: SRD 5.1 Ray of Enfeeblement (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

spikegrowth.name: Spike Growth
spikegrowth.desc: A 20-ft-radius patch within 150 ft becomes difficult ground: anyone moving through it, friend or foe, takes 2d4 piercing for each 5 ft. Concentration, 10 minutes. Not built: the camouflage and the Perception check.
spikegrowth.src: SRD 5.1 Spike Growth (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

plantgrowth.name: Plant Growth
plantgrowth.desc: The grass within 100 ft of a point you pick (within 150 ft) grows thick for the fight: every foot costs 4, so a square costs 20 ft, fliers excepted. Only where grass grows. Not built: the eight-hour version.
plantgrowth.src: SRD 5.1 Plant Growth (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/js/walls.js; the grass of the road maps; in the caves it waits)

giantinsect.name: Giant Insect
giantinsect.desc: Three giant spiders rise within 30 ft and fight for you, acting on your turn, till 0 HP or until concentration ends (the fight). Not built: the giant centipedes, wasps and scorpions (no sheets yet).
giantinsect.src: SRD 5.1 Giant Insect (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/data/summons.js; the giant spiders, so far)

antilifeshell.name: Antilife Shell
antilifeshell.desc: A 10-ft barrier about you that moves with you (concentration, 600 rounds): no creature but the undead and constructs steps through it, and melee blows across it are turned. Ranged attacks and spells pass. Moving so that one is forced through ends it. A Globe of Invulnerability it was cast from outside of is a hole in it: no barrier to a step that starts or ends in the globe, nor to a blow from or at one standing in it, and one the barrier's sweep carries into or out of the globe is not forced through.
antilifeshell.src: SRD 5.1 Antilife Shell (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/js/walls.js)

conjureelemental.name: Conjure Elemental
conjureelemental.desc: Cast ahead at camp (a minute, a 5th-level slot): an earth elemental or xorn walks into the fight on your side with its own turns, gone at 0 HP. Break your concentration and it turns on you and yours. Not built: air, fire and water elementals.
conjureelemental.src: SRD 5.1 Conjure Elemental (a minute to cast: at the camp, CAST AHEAD -- RULED 09-30, Griz: "Let's add the earth elemental to camp and hold off on the rest"; deep16/js/camp.js, deep16/js/walls.js)

cloudkill.name: Cloudkill
cloudkill.desc: A 20-ft sphere of poison fog within 120 ft (concentration, 100 rounds): nothing sees in, out or across it. CON save or 5d8 poison (half) on entering or starting a turn there (+1d8 a slot above 5th). It rolls 10 ft from you each turn; a Wind Wall scatters it. A creature under Protection from Poison saves with advantage.
cloudkill.src: SRD 5.1 Cloudkill (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/js/grimoire.js; the Underdark druid's 9th)

charmperson.name: Charm Person
charmperson.desc: A humanoid within 30 ft makes a WIS save (with advantage, since it is being fought) or is charmed: it will not strike or target you; harm from your side breaks it. Lasts the fight. Not built: extra targets at higher slots.
charmperson.src: SRD 5.1 Charm Person (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/js/grimoire.js; charmed: it will not strike or target its charmer, ai.js heroes)

animalfriendship.name: Animal Friendship
animalfriendship.desc: A beast of INT 3 or less within 30 ft makes a WIS save or is charmed: it will not strike or target you, and harm from you or your side breaks it. Lasts the fight. Not built: the 24-hour charm.
animalfriendship.src: SRD 5.1 Animal Friendship (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

polymorph.name: Polymorph
polymorph.desc: A creature within 60 ft becomes a bestiary beast of its CR or less (a hero: its level): a foe on a failed WIS save, an ally willing. The beast's HP come first, no spells; at 0 it reverts and the spell ends. Concentration.
polymorph.src: SRD 5.1 Polymorph (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/js/grimoire.js, deep16/js/features.js F.morph; the beasts are the world's, deep16/data/summons.js D.pool)

dominatebeast.name: Dominate Beast
dominatebeast.desc: A beast within 60 ft: WIS save (advantage, as it is being fought) or it fights on your side, on its own wits. Each time it is hurt it saves again, and a success frees it and ends the spell. Concentration, ten rounds. Not built: commanding it.
dominatebeast.src: SRD 5.1 Dominate Beast (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/js/grimoire.js; it fights for the caster's side, a save each time it is hurt)

dominateperson.name: Dominate Person
dominateperson.desc: A humanoid within 60 ft you can see: WIS save (advantage, as it is being fought) or it fights on your side, on its own wits -- one of the party goes over to the foe and fights by its class. Each time it is hurt it saves again, and a success frees it and ends the spell. Concentration, ten rounds. Not built: commanding it.
dominateperson.src: SRD 5.1 Dominate Person (5th, enchantment; 10-06, the grid's rules lane: deep16/js/grimoire.js dominate(), as Dominate Beast -- the spirit naga's two 5th-level slots)

windwall.name: Wind Wall
windwall.desc: A 50-ft wall of wind within 120 ft: STR save or 3d8 bludgeoning (half) as it rises. Arrows and bolts across it miss, small fliers cannot cross, and fog and gas clouds it cuts are torn apart. Concentration, ten rounds. Not built: loose objects blown up.
windwall.src: SRD 5.1 Wind Wall (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/js/walls.js)

walloffire.name: Wall of Fire
walloffire.desc: A 60-ft opaque wall of fire within 120 ft: DEX save or 5d8 fire (half) as it rises; after, 5d8 to whoever enters it or ends a turn in it or within 10 ft of its far side. +1d8 a slot above 4th. Concentration, ten rounds. Not built: the ring.
walloffire.src: SRD 5.1 Wall of Fire (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/js/walls.js)

wallofstone.name: Wall of Stone
wallofstone.desc: A 60-ft wall of stone within 120 ft (concentration, 100 rounds): nothing passes or sees through it. Those where it rises are shoved out, yours to your side. Not built: panel AC and hit points (it cannot be broken), permanence, shaping.
wallofstone.src: SRD 5.1 Wall of Stone (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/js/walls.js; the panels have no AC or hit points yet)

wallofthorns.name: Wall of Thorns
wallofthorns.desc: A 60-ft wall of thorns within 120 ft (concentration, 100 rounds): blocks sight, and each square costs 20 ft to cross (4 ft a foot). DEX save for half of 7d8 piercing as it grows, and 7d8 slashing on entering or ending a turn in it (+1d8 a slot). Not built: the ring.
wallofthorns.src: SRD 5.1 Wall of Thorns (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/js/walls.js)

conjureanimals.name: Conjure Animals
conjureanimals.desc: Beasts from the bestiary appear within 60 ft: one of CR 2, two of CR 1, four of CR 1/2 or eight of CR 1/4, your pick (twice as many from a 5th-level slot). They fight for you on their own, till 0 HP or concentration ends.
conjureanimals.src: SRD 5.1 Conjure Animals (the druid to twelve, 09-30: deep16/data/summons.js, deep16/js/grimoire.js summonSpell; RULED 09-30, Griz: the caster picks from the bestiary by CR, and they fight as if commanded)

conjurewoodlandbeings.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
conjurewoodlandbeings.desc: Fey creatures answer within 60 ft: one of CR 2, two of CR 1, four of CR 1/2 or eight of CR 1/4 (twice as many from a 6th-level slot), fighting for you. Greyed out for now: the bestiary has no fey to call. Concentration, the fight.
conjurewoodlandbeings.src: SRD 5.1 Conjure Woodland Beings (the druid to twelve, 09-30: the frame is built; the bestiary has no fey yet, so it waits greyed)

moonbeam.name: Moonbeam
moonbeam.desc: A 5-ft shaft of light within 120 ft: a creature entering it or starting a turn in it saves CON or takes 2d10 radiant (half on a save; +1d10 per slot above 2nd). An action moves it 60 ft. Concentration. Not built: the shapechanger rule.
moonbeam.src: SRD 5.1 Moonbeam (the druid to nine, 09-29: deep16/js/grimoire.js, a zone the caster moves)

flamingsphere.name: Flaming Sphere
flamingsphere.desc: A 5-ft ball of fire within 60 ft: anyone who ends a turn within 5 ft saves DEX or takes 2d6 fire (half on a save; +1d6 per slot above 2nd). A bonus action rolls it 30 ft, ramming what it meets. Concentration.
flamingsphere.src: SRD 5.1 Flaming Sphere (the druid to nine, 09-29: deep16/js/grimoire.js, a zone the caster rolls)

spiritualweapon.name: Spiritual Weapon
spiritualweapon.src: SRD 5.1 Spiritual Weapon (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js); RULED 09-28g (Griz): Ingrith is a cleric in the 8-bit game too: her spells cast in its battle (js/battle.js)
spiritualweapon.desc: Bonus action. A floating weapon of force strikes a foe now and again each round: spell attack, 1d8 + WIS force. Ten rounds.

wardingbond.name: Warding Bond
wardingbond.desc: Touch an adjacent ally: +1 AC and saves, and half of all damage they take; you take the same amount they do. Ends if you drop, or if you are over 60 ft apart as its turn starts. Lasts the fight.
wardingbond.src: SRD 5.1 Warding Bond (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

beaconofhope.name: Beacon of Hope
beaconofhope.desc: Your allies within 30 ft: advantage on WIS saves, and healing spells on them always roll their maximum. Concentration, ten rounds.
beaconofhope.src: SRD 5.1 Beacon of Hope (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

bestowcurse.name: Bestow Curse
bestowcurse.desc: Touch: WIS save or cursed. You pick: your attacks on it add 1d8 necrotic, or its attacks on you are at disadvantage. Concentration, ten rounds. Not built: the ability-check and lost-turn curses, longer durations from higher slots.
bestowcurse.src: SRD 5.1 Bestow Curse (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

blink.name: Blink
blink.desc: Yourself, ten rounds: at the end of each of your turns roll a d20; on 11 or more you slip out of the world until your next turn starts, untargetable. Not built: choosing where you return.

calllightning.name: Call Lightning
calllightning.desc: Needs open sky. A bolt strikes a point within 120 ft: DEX save or 3d10 lightning (half) to all within 5 ft; each later turn an action calls another, no slot. +1d10 a slot above 3rd. Concentration, the fight. Not built: the storm bonus.
calllightning.src: SRD 5.1 Call Lightning (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

dispelmagic.name: Dispel Magic
dispelmagic.desc: A creature within 120 ft loses the magic on it: its own concentration, spells others hold on it, and wards like Mage Armor, Sanctuary or Mirror Image. A held spell up to the slot's level (3rd at least) ends; a higher one needs your spellcasting check against 10 + its level. Or an empty square in the area of a spell (a Darkness, a Web, a Stinking Cloud): that spell ends by the same rule. Not built: objects. A creature's own power (the darkmantle's aura) is no spell, and stays.
dispelmagic.src: SRD 5.1 Dispel Magic (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

counterspell.name: Counterspell
counterspell.desc: Reaction, offered when you see a foe within 60 ft casting a spell: one of the slot's level or lower (3rd at least) fails; a higher one needs your spellcasting check against 10 + its level. Spends the slot you pick; never cast from the list.

fear.name: Fear
fear.desc: A 30-ft cone, friends too: WIS save or frightened, running from you on each of its turns (a hero drops their weapon for a turn). It saves again only at a turn's end out of your sight. Concentration, ten rounds.

haste.name: Haste
haste.desc: A willing ally within 30 ft: +2 AC, advantage on DEX saves, double speed, one more attack each turn; a lost turn when it ends. Concentration, ten rounds. Not built: the extra action's Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object.

fly.name: Fly
fly.desc: A willing creature you touch flies, 60 ft, for the fight. When the spell ends it falls if it is still aloft. Concentration, ten rounds. Not built: a second creature from a higher slot.
fly.src: SRD 5.1 Fly (the grid's rules, 10-08: flight at a height, Griz: "yes to fly spell"; deep16/js/grimoire.js)

hypnoticpattern.name: Hypnotic Pattern
hypnoticpattern.desc: A 30-ft cube within 120 ft, friends too: those who can see it make a WIS save or are charmed, incapacitated and rooted till hurt. Concentration, ten rounds. Not built: waking one by shaking it.
hypnoticpattern.src: SRD 5.1 Hypnotic Pattern (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

masshealingword.name: Mass Healing Word
masshealingword.desc: Bonus action. Up to six allies within 60 ft regain 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier each (+1d4 a slot above 3rd); the fallen get up.
masshealingword.src: SRD 5.1 Mass Healing Word (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

protectionfromenergy.name: Protection from Energy
protectionfromenergy.desc: Touch: one ally takes half damage from one element, the one the foes throw most (fire, cold, lightning, acid or thunder); the game picks it. Concentration, the fight.
protectionfromenergy.src: SRD 5.1 Protection from Energy (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

slow.name: Slow
slow.desc: Up to six foes in a 40-ft cube within 120 ft: WIS save or slowed: -2 AC and DEX saves, half speed, no reactions, one attack. They save again at each turn's end. Concentration, ten rounds. Not built: action or bonus action, not both; delayed spells.

spiritguardians.name: Spirit Guardians
spiritguardians.desc: Yourself: spirits ring you at 15 ft. Your foes there move at half speed, and on entering (once a turn) or starting a turn there take 3d8 radiant, WIS save for half; +1d8 a slot above 3rd. Concentration, the fight.
spiritguardians.src: SRD 5.1 Spirit Guardians (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

vampirictouch.name: Vampiric Touch
vampirictouch.desc: Touch: melee spell attack, 3d6 necrotic, and you regain half of it as HP; +1d6 a slot above 3rd. Each later turn an action repeats the touch, no slot. Concentration, ten rounds.
vampirictouch.src: SRD 5.1 Vampiric Touch (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

ropetrick.name: Rope Trick
ropetrick.desc: A rope up into a hidden space for the party: a short rest anywhere a tent could go. It takes a skein of Gulch Silk.
ropetrick.src: SRD 5.1 Rope Trick; RULED 09-28: a short rest like the tent, spending a skein of Gulch Silk (the game's first consumed components)

tinyhut.name: Tiny Hut
tinyhut.desc: A dome of force over the party for the night: a long rest where a tent could go. Cast from the book as a ritual; it breaks a Dome Whorl.
tinyhut.src: SRD 5.1 Leomund's Tiny Hut (the SRD's Tiny Hut, a ritual); RULED 09-28: a long rest where a tent goes, counted with the rest (clocks, morning, save), spending a snail shell from Percy's

findfamiliar.name: Find Familiar
findfamiliar.desc: An hour's ritual: a spirit takes the shape of a small creature of the ground you stand on, and serves you. It darts at the foes so the next blow lands better; a blast that catches you ends it.
findfamiliar.src: SRD 5.1 Find Familiar (a ritual: from the book, no slot); REINSTATED 09-29 (Griz): cast from the field menu, the shape by the ground; a bundle of Calling Herbs burned each casting, 500 sp at Mama's only (RULED 09-29, Griz: past the usual hand-wave of components); the 8-bit battle: the first ally to attack after the wizard's turn, if he does not attack, has advantage (his own attack if he does); not a target, but a blast that catches the wizard catches it (RULED 09-29)

banishment.name: Banishment
banishment.desc: A creature within 60 ft: CHA save or it vanishes from the field, turns skipped, until you lose concentration or ten rounds pass; it returns where it stood. A celestial, elemental, fey or fiend held all ten rounds doesn't return. Not built: extra targets from higher slots.

blacktentacles.name: Black Tentacles
blacktentacles.desc: A 20-ft square within 90 ft turns to difficult ground, friends too. Entering it or starting a turn there: DEX save or 3d6 bludgeoning and restrained; the held take 3d6 each turn and break free by an action's STR or DEX check. Concentration, ten rounds.
blacktentacles.src: SRD 5.1 Black Tentacles (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

blight.name: Blight
blight.desc: A foe within 30 ft: CON save or 8d8 necrotic (half on a save); +1d8 a slot above 4th. The dead and the made (undead, constructs) take nothing. Not built: the plant rules.

confusion.name: Confusion
confusion.desc: A 10-ft sphere within 90 ft, friends too: WIS save or confused, and no reactions. Each turn a d10: 1 wanders, 2-6 stands, 7-8 strikes a random neighbour, 9-10 acts. WIS ends it at turn's end. Concentration, ten rounds. Not built: bigger spheres from higher slots.

deathward.name: Death Ward
deathward.desc: Touch: the first blow that would drop the ally to 0 HP leaves them at 1 instead, and the ward ends. Lasts the fight. Not built: the ward against instant-death effects.
deathward.src: SRD 5.1 Death Ward (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

dimensiondoor.name: Dimension Door
dimensiondoor.desc: You, and one ally within 5 ft, step to any square you can see within 500 ft. Not built: destinations you cannot see, named by distance and direction.
dimensiondoor.src: SRD 5.1 Dimension Door (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

fireshield.name: Fire Shield
fireshield.desc: Yourself: flames that halve one element and burn back 2d8 at melee attackers beside you: chill (fire halved, cold back) if a foe knows fire spells, else warm (cold halved, fire back). Lasts the fight. Not built: the light it sheds.
fireshield.src: SRD 5.1 Fire Shield (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

freedomofmovement.name: Freedom of Movement
freedomofmovement.desc: Touch: difficult ground does not slow them, and restraint, holds and grapples cannot take them (any on them end). Lasts the fight. Not built: immunity to speed-slowing magic.
freedomofmovement.src: SRD 5.1 Freedom of Movement (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

guardianoffaith.name: Guardian of Faith
guardianoffaith.desc: A spectral guardian at a point within 30 ft: a foe coming within 10 ft of it, or starting a turn there, takes 20 radiant (DEX save for half), once a turn. It is gone after dealing 60. Lasts the fight.
guardianoffaith.src: SRD 5.1 Guardian of Faith (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

phantasmalkiller.name: Phantasmal Killer
phantasmalkiller.desc: A creature within 120 ft: WIS save or frightened. At the end of each of its turns, WIS save or 4d10 psychic; a success ends the spell. +1d10 a slot above 4th. Concentration, ten rounds.
phantasmalkiller.src: SRD 5.1 Phantasmal Killer (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

resilientsphere.name: Resilient Sphere
resilientsphere.desc: A creature within 30 ft is sealed in force: DEX save for a foe, no save for an ally. It cannot be touched and loses its turns until you let go or ten rounds pass. Concentration. Not built: rolling the sphere; the size limit.
resilientsphere.src: SRD 5.1 Resilient Sphere (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.desc: Melee spell attack, no damage: a hit poisons the target with disease. At the end of each of its turns, CON save: three failures and it goes blind, three successes and it clears. Not built: the other five diseases.

dispelevilandgood.name: Dispel Evil and Good
dispelevilandgood.desc: Concentration, 10 rounds: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and the undead attack you at disadvantage. Not built: Break Enchantment and Dismissal.
dispelevilandgood.src: SRD 5.1 Dispel Evil and Good (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

flamestrike.name: Flame Strike
flamestrike.desc: A 10-ft-radius column of divine fire within 60 ft: DEX save for half of 4d6 fire and 4d6 radiant, to everyone caught (+1d6 fire a slot above 5th).
flamestrike.src: SRD 5.1 Flame Strike (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

greaterrestoration.name: Greater Restoration
greaterrestoration.desc: Touch: ends one effect, the worst first: Flesh to Stone's stoning, a charm, a curse, Enfeeblement or Feeblemind, or a lowered HP maximum (Harm, the crawlers). Not built: exhaustion, curing disease.
greaterrestoration.src: SRD 5.1 Greater Restoration (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

insectplague.name: Insect Plague
insectplague.desc: A 20-ft sphere of locusts within 300 ft (concentration, 100 rounds): difficult ground. CON save or 4d10 piercing (half) as it forms, on entering it, and on ending a turn there (+1d10 a slot above 5th). Not built: the light obscurement.
insectplague.src: SRD 5.1 Insect Plague (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

masscurewounds.name: Mass Cure Wounds
masscurewounds.desc: Up to six allies within 60 ft each regain 3d8 + your spellcasting modifier (+1d8 a slot above 5th). The fallen get back up.
masscurewounds.src: SRD 5.1 Mass Cure Wounds (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

chainlightning.name: Chain Lightning
chainlightning.desc: A creature within 150 ft and up to three more foes within 30 ft of it: DEX save for half of 10d8 lightning, one roll for all. The game picks the other three. Not built: extra bolts from higher slots.
chainlightning.src: SRD 5.1 Chain Lightning (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

circleofdeath.name: Circle of Death
circleofdeath.desc: A 60-ft-radius sphere of negative energy within 150 ft: CON save for half of 8d6 necrotic, to everyone caught (+2d6 a slot above 6th).
circleofdeath.src: SRD 5.1 Circle of Death (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
disintegrate.desc: A green ray at a creature within 60 ft: DEX save or 10d6+40 force; a save takes nothing. Not built: the dust (it simply drops at 0 HP), objects, +3d6 from higher slots.

eyebite.name: Eyebite
eyebite.desc: Concentration, 10 rounds. Each action, one creature within 60 ft that hasn't saved against this casting: WIS save or it sleeps (a tough foe; wakes if hurt), panics and runs (within 10 ft), or is sickened (disadvantage on attacks and ability checks); the game picks. Sickened: WIS at each turn's end. Panic ends 60 ft off and out of your sight. All lift when concentration ends. Not built: waking a sleeper by an action.

fleshtostone.name: Flesh to Stone
fleshtostone.desc: A creature within 60 ft (concentration, 10 rounds): CON save or restrained as it stiffens. At the end of each of its turns, CON save: three failures and it is stone, out of the fight; three successes and it is free. Lose concentration first and it frees.
fleshtostone.src: SRD 5.1 Flesh to Stone (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

freezingsphere.name: Freezing Sphere
freezingsphere.desc: A 60-ft-radius sphere of frost within 300 ft: CON save for half of 10d6 cold, to everyone caught (+1d6 a slot above 6th). Not built: the globe held in hand, freezing water.
freezingsphere.src: SRD 5.1 Freezing Sphere (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

globeofinvulnerability.name: Globe of Invulnerability
globeofinvulnerability.desc: A 10-ft globe about you, fixed where cast (concentration, 10 rounds): a spell of 5th level or lower (one more per slot above 6th), cast from outside, does nothing to those inside, whatever slot it came from: save spells, spell attacks, darts, touches and cantrips alike, and what a spell leaves behind: its clouds, webs, ground and walls (Cloudkill, Stinking Cloud, Web, Grease, Spike Growth, Sleet Storm, Moonbeam, Wall of Fire, Spirit Guardians and the rest) do nothing to those inside, wherever the caster has moved since, and the globe's squares are no part of their area (no difficult ground, no wall there); raised after the zone was laid, it shelters those inside all the same (the card says so). What a spell left on a creature that has stepped in since is stopped too, each turn it would be felt: a Phantasmal Killer's bite, an Acid Arrow's second, Contagion's saves, the stone, a Bestow Curse's or a Hunter's Mark's extra die, a Command, Fear's run, Confusion's turn, Regenerate's and Heroism's tick, a Sanctuary ward (a Hold, a Slow, a fright and the rest that only bind it are not). A spell used again (the next Call Lightning, Sunbeam, Heat Metal flare, Moonbeam or Flaming Sphere move, Spiritual Weapon or Arcane Sword swing, Vampiric Touch, Eyebite) is cast from where it was first cast, however far its caster has walked since. The AI and the player's picker pass a globed target by (the click says why: inside the globe). The fog and the dark are no part of the globe's squares either: a Fog Cloud, Darkness, Stinking Cloud, Cloudkill or Sleet Storm cast from outside hides nothing inside it (a line of sight that crosses only the globe's squares of the cloud is clear, and one inside is not in its dark), and Daylight cast from outside does not light them.
globeofinvulnerability.src: SRD 5.1 Globe of Invulnerability (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

harm.name: Harm
harm.desc: A creature within 60 ft: CON save for half of 14d6 necrotic, never below 1 HP. On a failure its hit point maximum falls by the damage taken, for the fight.

heal.name: Heal
heal.desc: An ally within 60 ft regains 70 HP (+10 a slot above 6th); blindness, deafness and disease (Contagion) end. The fallen get up. Not built: the undead and construct exception.

irresistibledance.name: Irresistible Dance
irresistibledance.desc: A creature within 30 ft dances (concentration, 10 rounds), no first save: no movement, its attacks and DEX saves at disadvantage, attacks at it with advantage. Each turn its action may be a WIS save to stop: a player's dancer is asked at its turn's start (SHAKE IT OFF: the save, the action spent; or FIGHT ON: no save, the action kept, still no move and still at disadvantage); the AI always saves.
irresistibledance.src: SRD 5.1 Irresistible Dance (the class NPCs, 09-28; a player's dancer chooses, 10-01: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

sunbeam.name: Sunbeam
sunbeam.desc: A 60-ft line of sunlight: CON save for half of 6d8 radiant, and a failure blinds until the end of its next turn. Concentration, 10 rounds: a new line every action, free. Not built: the light in your hand, the undead's disadvantage.

arcanesword.name: Arcane Sword
arcanesword.desc: A sword of force within 60 ft (concentration, 10 rounds): a spell attack for 3d10 force, then each turn a bonus action moves it up to 20 ft and it strikes a foe within 25 ft of it. Farther off, it moves 20 ft and doesn't strike. Not built: needing a spot you can see.
arcanesword.src: SRD 5.1 Arcane Sword (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

delayedblastfireball.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
delayedblastfireball.desc: A bead of fire at a point within 150 ft (concentration, 10 rounds). It bursts when you let go, lose concentration or time runs out: 12d6 fire, +1d6 per turn it waited (to 22d6), 20-ft sphere, DEX half. Not built: touching or throwing it.
delayedblastfireball.src: SRD 5.1 Delayed Blast Fireball (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

divineword.name: Divine Word
divineword.desc: Bonus action. Every foe you can see within 30 ft that can hear you: CHA save, or by current HP: 20 or fewer drops, 30 deafened, blinded and stunned, 40 deafened and blinded, 50 deafened for ten of its turns; over 50 untouched. Celestials, elementals, fey and fiends that fail leave the fight. Not built: the ten minutes and the hour.
divineword.src: SRD 5.1 Divine Word (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

etherealness.name: Etherealness
etherealness.desc: You step into the Ethereal: untargetable and out of the fight until the start of your next turn. Not built: the eight hours, moving about the Ethereal.

fingerofdeath.name: Finger of Death
fingerofdeath.desc: A creature within 60 ft: CON save for half of 7d8+30 necrotic. Not built: a humanoid it kills rising as your zombie.
fingerofdeath.src: SRD 5.1 Finger of Death (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

firestorm.name: Fire Storm
firestorm.desc: A storm of flame in a 20-ft-radius area within 150 ft: DEX save for half of 7d10 fire, to everyone caught. Not built: the SRD's ten-cube shape (a round area here).
firestorm.src: SRD 5.1 Fire Storm (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

prismaticspray.name: Prismatic Spray
prismaticspray.desc: A 60-ft cone: each creature caught saves DEX and rolls a ray. A d8 gives 10d6 fire, acid, lightning, poison or cold (half), or restrained (indigo), or blinded two turns (violet), or two rays. Not built: the petrifying and the banishing.
prismaticspray.src: SRD 5.1 Prismatic Spray (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.desc: Touch: 4d8+15 HP now, then 1 HP at the start of each of its turns for the fight. Not built: regrowing severed limbs.

symbol.name: Symbol
symbol.desc: Lay a glyph on a square beside you. The first foe to step on it sets it off: every foe within 60 ft, WIS save or stunned (CON save at each turn's end to shake it). Not built: the other seven glyphs, other triggers, hiding it.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.desc: A 100-ft-radius area within 500 ft (concentration, 10 rounds): difficult ground. At the start of each creature's turn there, DEX save or prone, and a concentrating one makes a CON save or loses it. Not built: fissures, structures.

feeblemind.name: Feeblemind
feeblemind.desc: A creature within 150 ft takes 4d6 psychic, then INT save or its mind is gone for the fight: no spells, and its concentration ends. Not built: INT and CHA of 1, the repeat save, cures.

holyaura.name: Holy Aura
holyaura.desc: You and allies within 30 ft (concentration, 10 rounds): advantage on every save, and attacks at them have disadvantage. Not built: the blinding flash against fiends and undead, the dim light.
holyaura.src: SRD 5.1 Holy Aura (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

maze.name: Maze
maze.desc: A creature within 60 ft, no save: sent into a labyrinth and out of the fight (concentration, 100 rounds). At the end of each of its turns it rolls d20 + INT modifier and escapes on 20 or more. Not built: a minotaur's automatic escape.

mindblank.name: Mind Blank
mindblank.desc: Touch: immune to psychic damage and the charmed condition for the fight. Not built: the shield against divination and mind reading.
mindblank.src: SRD 5.1 Mind Blank (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

powerwordstun.name: Power Word Stun
powerwordstun.desc: A creature within 60 ft, no save: stunned if it has 150 HP or fewer, otherwise nothing. CON save at the end of each of its turns to shake it off.
powerwordstun.src: SRD 5.1 Power Word Stun (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

sunburst.name: Sunburst
sunburst.desc: A 60-ft-radius burst of sunlight within 150 ft: CON save for half of 12d6 radiant; a failure blinds, with a CON save at the end of each turn to see again. Ends spell-made darkness there. Not built: the undead's disadvantage.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.desc: Touch: advantage on its attacks and saves, and attacks at it have disadvantage, for the fight. Not built: advantage on ability checks, never being surprised.

massheal.name: Mass Heal
massheal.desc: You and every ally you can see share 700 HP, the most hurt first (the fallen too); blindness, deafness and disease (Contagion) end. Not built: the undead and construct exception.
massheal.src: SRD 5.1 Mass Heal (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

meteorswarm.name: Meteor Swarm
meteorswarm.desc: Four 40-ft-radius spheres of fire and rock within 1 mile: one at your point, three on foes (the game picks). DEX save for half of 20d6 fire and 20d6 bludgeoning, each creature once, friend or foe.
meteorswarm.src: SRD 5.1 Meteor Swarm (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

powerwordkill.name: Power Word Kill
powerwordkill.desc: A creature within 60 ft, no save: dropped to 0 HP if it has 100 HP or fewer, otherwise nothing.
powerwordkill.src: SRD 5.1 Power Word Kill (the class NPCs, 09-28: deep16/js/grimoire.js)

weird.name: Weird
weird.desc: A 30-ft sphere within 120 ft (concentration, 10 rounds): each foe in it, WIS save or frightened, then at the end of each of its turns WIS save or 4d10 psychic; a save ends it for that one.
